title: Two-year retention of purchasing, return, disposal and destruction records
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.16(1), a pharmacist and pharmacy shall maintain prescription records, purchasing and return records, and disposal and destruction records in a readily retrievable manner for at least two years.
exam_relevance: Tests the retention period and the readily retrievable standard for the return and disposal records that accompany returned, quarantined and destroyed medication.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: minimum retention of prescription, purchasing and return, and disposal and destruction records
numeric_facts.conditions: maintained in a readily retrievable manner

common_confusions: The duty is placed on both the pharmacist and the pharmacy.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
